values.note: 58 sites: 24 water/electric, 17 full-hookup (sewer; 9 of them pull-throughs: 04-08, 16-21), 11 waterfront (14, 35-44; water/electric) and 6 tent sites (45-50, with water and electric). Back-in pads are 27-72 ft; many are on a 5-45 degree slope, stated site by site. No tents on pull-through, waterfront or full-hookup sites.

values.note: Macon-Bibb County's Rec1 catalog; an account is needed to book. It opens 60 days out (maxDaysOut 60). Stay limits: 7 nights within 30 days at waterfront and full-hookup sites, 14 at electric/water and tent sites. Cancel by phone two business days before arrival for a refund.

values.note: $27 a night for a water/electric RV site, $30 for a full-hookup (sewer) or waterfront site; tent sites $23. Same rate on weekdays and weekends, 2026 and 2027. More than 4 campers on a site: $3 a day each; a boat $5 a day. Read 2026-10-29.

note: Macon-Bibb County's Lake Tobesofkee recreation area. Register at the gate on arrival; campers must be 21+. Many sites slope, stated site by site in the booking catalog.
